purpose: Frozen Track-A directional DQNGuard evaluation policy for the 10 canonical L2O backbones / 20 directed cells.
invariants: The true evaluation target is excluded from DQN fitting, threshold selection, HPO, retries, and method selection.
The DQN open calibration set is surrogate-only; mix_true_open must remain false.
The score threshold is selected from known calibration scores only.
The target test split is consumed only by the final frozen evaluation.
Only a COMPLETE canonical backbone with exact artifact/checkpoint/config provenance may be evaluated.
Reverse directional reuse is permitted only within the same unordered canonical excluded pair.
